messages.author: f3f2cdf1f7c65ea4
messages.subject: How to embed the plotting of ggplot into other software ?
parts: Just like RStudio can embed the plotting of ggplot to itself, I also want to embed that into other software, does anyone know how to do that ? What is the exact output of ggplot ? Thanks

messages.author: 5c27625168797e5f
messages.subject: Re: How to embed the plotting of ggplot into other software ?
parts: Excel.link uses the image file export feature (so it takes the ggplot canvas and uses the normal png etc export command to pass it through to excel. Works surprisingly well). Plotly/htmlwidgets might be more what you want though, you could write a UI in javascript. If you want to know how the ggplot2 API works, you'd be best off looking at the documentation for the ggplot2 API. Here's a semi-decent article that goes over some stuff: https://www.data-imaginist.com/2017/beneath-the-canvas/
